success.title: Twishimira Intsinzi: Abanyeshuri bacu bari mu ba mbere mu Rwanda
success.description: Saint Joseph TSS Nzuki yishimira intsinzi nkuru! Abanyeshuri babiri, Karangwa Irakoze Roben na Aime Senga Prosper, bo mu ishami rya Automobile Technology (AUT) mu mwaka wa S6, bari mu 10 ba mbere mu gihugu mu bisubizo bya Transport and Logistics by'umwaka wa 2025. Iyi ntsinzi igaragaza umwete wabo n'uburezi bwiza butangwa n'ishuri ryacu.

admission.title: Ibisabwa mu Kwiyandikisha
admission.subtitle: Tegura ibi bipapuro, hanyuma wohereze ubusabe hasi.
admission.heroTitle: Tegura ejo hazaza hawe ukoresheje ubuhanga bufite agaciro
admission.heroSubtitle: Injira muri Saint Joseph TSS Nzuki wige imyuga y'ibikorwa: imodoka, ubwubatsi, ubudozi n'ububaji.
admission.journeyTitle: Urugendo rwawe rwo kuza muri SJTSS
admission.programsSubtitle: Hitamo inzira yihariye iguha ubumenyi bw'ibikorwa bufite agaciro ku isoko.
admission.progAutoDesc: Amahugurwa y'ibikorwa: gusana, gukosora moteri, gucukumbura amakosa n'ibikoresho by'agare.
admission.progBuildDesc: Wige ubwubatsi, gushushanya no kuyobora imirimo y'ubwubatsi.
admission.progTradeDesc: Wige guca, kuboha, gukora ibikoresho by'ibiti n'ubuhanga bw'amashuri y'imyuga.
admission.feesText: Twifuzaga ko uburezi bw'imyuga bufatika. Inyandiko z'ibisabwa kuri buri rwego ziraboneka.
admission.faqDeadlineQ: Ni ryari igihe cyo kurangiza kwiyandikisha?
admission.faqDeadlineA: Kwiyandikisha ku mwaka w'amashuri 2026/2027 birafunguye. Twagutegeka kwiyandikisha hakiri kare.
admission.faqBoardingA: Yego, dufite internat yizewe y'abahungu n'abakobwa.
admission.faqAidA: Ubufasha buke buhari ku banyeshuri b'umwete bafite ibibazo by'amafaranga. Vugana n'ubuyobozi.
admission.formIntro: Intambwe 4 ngufi. Suzuma amakuru yawe mbere yo kohereza. Umwanya wawe muri Saint Joseph TSS utangirira hano.
admission.reviewHint: Reba niba byose ari byo, hanyuma wohereze. Kanda Hindura niba ushaka guhindura igice.
admission.uploadHint: PDF cyangwa amafoto — kanda uhitemo dosiye
admission.successContact: Niba ufite ikibazo, vugana n'ishuri ukoresheje amakuru akurikira.
admission.payFeesBody: Nyamuneka ishyura amafaranga y'iyandikisha angana na 5,000 RWF ukoresheje Mobile Money.
admission.payFeesCallFirst: Mbere yo kwishyura, hamagara iyi nomero ubasabe gusuzuma ubusabe bwawe.
admission.payFeesCheckAccepted: Iyo baguhaye uburenganzira bwo kwishyura, ushobora kureba niba wakiriwe ukoresheje nomero y'iyandikisha.
admission.saveNumberHint: Bika iyi nomero. Uzayikoreshe usuzuma ubusabe bwawe.
admission.trackIntro: Andika nomero y'iyandikisha wayakiriye nyuma yo kohereza.
admission.faqTrackA: Nyuma yo kohereza, uhabwa nomero y'iyandikisha. Yandike mu gice Suzuma ubusabe kuri iyi paji kugira ngo urebe imiterere.
